es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: Suno Faces Another Copyright Suit from Universal Music and Sony Music Despite Its Recent Licensing Deals: ‘v6 Is Not a Fresh Start; It Is the Fruit of the Same Poisoned Tree’
items.summary: Universal Music y Sony Music presentaron una nueva demanda contra Suno, alegando que entrenó su IA con un gran número de grabaciones protegidas sin permiso; la acción se presentó en un tribunal federal de Massachusetts mientras continúa el proceso previo.

items.title: Universal Music Sues DistroKid for Copyright Infringement and Deceptive Trade Practices, Says the Distributor ‘Is Flooding Platforms With AI-Generated Slop’
items.summary: Universal Music Group interpuso una demanda de 52 páginas contra DistroKid en un tribunal federal de Delaware, acusando al distribuidor de prácticas comerciales engañosas y de infringir derechos de autor al difundir en plataformas música generada por IA sin autorización.

items.title: Suno estrena sus modelos v6 con Warner, BMG y Believe
items.summary: Suno lanzó su suite de modelos v6, desarrollada junto a Warner Music Group, BMG y Believe, marcando la primera colaboración con socios de la industria; al mismo tiempo, la empresa retiró sus modelos anteriores.

items.title: Landmark termination rights ruling not the “copyright emergency” music publishers claim, songwriter tells US Supreme Court
items.summary: When America’s Fifth Circuit Appeals Court backed a songwriter-friendly interpretation of the termination right in US copyright law, the majors bought the song that prompted that ruling and asked the Supreme Court to intervene. The writer of that song has now urged the top court to not get involved

items.title: ¿De quién es la música? Derechos de autor en la era de la inteligencia artificial
Universal and Warner tell judge ‘new use’ clause in AFM agreement is “clear and unambiguous” and does not apply to their AI deals
items.summary: In June the American Federation Of Musicians sued Universal and Warner over their AI deals, insisting the majors should be sharing their AI money with the union’s members under its Sound Recording Labor Agreement. Both sides have made new court filings as the majors try to get the lawsuit dismissed

Cyril Vetter Formally Opposes the Major Labels’ ‘Off Base’ Supreme Court Appeal Amid High-Stakes Copyright Recapture Showdown
items.summary: Songwriter Cyril Vetter is firing back against the major labels’ aggressive push to bring their high-stakes copyright recapture case before the Supreme Court. The Louisiana-born “Double Shot (Of My Baby’s Love)” co-writer Vetter just recently laid out his opposition arguments across 37 detailed pages, after the majors…

items.title: UMG firma un acuerdo global de IA con ElevenLabs
items.summary: Universal Music Group (UMG) ha firmado un acuerdo de licencia plurianual con ElevenLabs, la compañía de inteligencia artificial de audio valorada en 11.000 millones de dólares. Es el primer pacto de ElevenLabs con una gran discográfica y contempla el lanzamiento de una nueva plataforma de música con IA para fans, ademá…

tip.title: Guarda evidencia de la fecha de creación
tip.body: Un correo a ti mismo con el archivo adjunto, un repositorio con historial o un servicio de sellado de tiempo cuestan poco y construyen una línea de tiempo defendible.

en.subtitle: Stories published by real industry outlets, each linked to its original article. No invented news.

items.title: Suno Faces Another Copyright Suit from Universal Music and Sony Music Despite Its Recent Licensing Deals: ‘v6 Is Not a Fresh Start; It Is the Fruit of the Same Poisoned Tree’
items.summary: Universal Music and Sony Music filed a new lawsuit against Suno, alleging it trained its AI on a large number of copyrighted recordings without permission; the action was filed in a Massachusetts federal court while the earlier suit remains pending.

items.title: Universal Music Sues DistroKid for Copyright Infringement and Deceptive Trade Practices, Says the Distributor ‘Is Flooding Platforms With AI-Generated Slop’
items.summary: Universal Music Group filed a 52‑page complaint against DistroKid in a Delaware federal court, accusing the distributor of deceptive trade practices and of copyright infringement by flooding platforms with AI‑generated music without authorization.

items.title: Suno estrena sus modelos v6 con Warner, BMG y Believe
items.summary: Suno released its v6 model suite, created in partnership with Warner Music Group, BMG and Believe, representing its first industry‑partner development; simultaneously, the company withdrew its earlier previous models entirely.

tip.title: Keep evidence of your creation date
tip.body: An email to yourself with the file attached, a repository with history, or a timestamping service cost little and build a defensible timeline.
